name: The Prospector
source:
You play as Clark and Lucas, two scientists who are breaking into their government-controlled laboratory in search of answers to a mysterious blackout... and the whereabouts of their experimental human clone.

[From [url=https://moonviewingtruth.itch.io/the-prospector-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演克拉克和卢卡斯，两位科学家闯入政府控制的实验室，寻找神秘停电的答案……以及他们的实验性克隆人的下落。

[来自[url=https://moonviewingtruth.itch.io/the-prospector-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
